items.summary: Legal risk disposition: blocked for the gated product's public beta or full launch; conditional for ordinary reversible fleet growth; counsel_required for upstream data rights, jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment, vendor/DPA obligations, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep the gated product private and keep external outreach unsent. Evidence: source documentation confirms API access mechanics but does not establish rights to store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize returned data. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, 10 unknown, with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics is configured for 39 sites, but source-permission errors remain. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission and $0 site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, and attribution claims remain unsupported. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a general growth blocker.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active for the gated product. Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; no task has sufficient evidence for closure. Open tasks are source rights, alert-data flow and retention, GA4 consent/configuration, and logs/vendors/incident handling. Existing evidence is partial: official source documentation and terms, repository/configuration data-flow files, privacy and cookie pages, and draft terms are present, but none establish complete launch readiness. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering source provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, change the private gate, enable tracking, or expand monetization. Close no task this cycle.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot API deal and price-history data = counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and rights, caching/display/alert terms, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results = evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics = evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data = evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention and access controls, vendor terms/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator and vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Compliance, site, analytics, revenue, and launch evidence support containment-only execution for rights-sensitive and security-sensitive changes. Preserve consent and withdrawal behavior, cookie and analytics disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims substantiation, data provenance and rights, copyright/trademark boundaries, platform-policy limits, and regulated or age-sensitive safeguards where applicable. Private or gated sites require an explicit keep-private decision and completed checklist before exposure. No go-live proposal is supported. Continue only existing read-only legal/security evidence, failure repair-or-close, and period-aligned attribution reconciliation.
